Commitment.title: Commitment
Commitment.description: A financial commitment (verplichting) tracked from the moment it becomes legally binding (PO signed, raamovereenkomst agreed, arbeidscontract executed, subsidiebeschikking awarded) through delivery, invoicing, payment, and closure. Drives budget-blocking at commitment-time (REQ-VPL-001) and mandate enforcement on aangaan (REQ-VPL-002). The status field is the lifecycle field; every state change is recorded as an immutable Verplichtingsmutatie (D1). The tegenpartij is an embedded vendor reference (kvk/naam/iban) — not a bespoke customer schema; a customer/contact is a Nextcloud entity (ADR).

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration owning this verplichting for tenant isolation (IDOR-safe scoping).
administrationId.title: Administration ID

commitmentNumber.description: Operator-assigned unique commitment number within the administration.
commitmentNumber.title: Commitment Number

sourceReference.description: Provenance reference for auto-materialised commitments (REQ-VPL-010): the poNumber of the approved PurchaseOrder or the contractNumber of the signed Contract this Verplichting was raised from. Used as the idempotency key so a repeated approval/signature transition never creates a duplicate commitment. Null for manually-created commitments.
sourceReference.title: Source Reference

commitmentDate.description: Date the commitment became legally binding (set when moved to aangegaan).
commitmentDate.title: Commitment Date

termStart.description: Start of the commitment term. Used to derive per-boekjaar regels for multi-year raamovereenkomsten (REQ-VPL-004).
termStart.title: Term Start

termEnd.description: End of the commitment term. Snapped to boekjaar boundaries for regel creation (D10).
termEnd.title: Term End

counterparty.description: Embedded counterparty reference (vendor/supplier). A customer/contact is a Nextcloud entity, not a bespoke schema; this carries only the external reference fields needed for the commitment and three-way match.

cocNumber.description: Chamber of Commerce number (user-entered; external validation is out of scope).
cocNumber.title: CoC Number

contactId.description: Optional reference to a Nextcloud contact entity (OCP\Contacts\IManager) for the counterparty.
contactId.title: Contact ID

counterparty.title: Counterparty

totalAmountExclVat.description: Total commitment amount excluding VAT, in minor units (EUR cents).
totalAmountExclVat.title: Total Amount Excl VAT

totalAmountInclVat.description: Total commitment amount including VAT, in minor units (EUR cents).
totalAmountInclVat.title: Total Amount Incl VAT

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code. EUR-only in this tier.
currency.title: Currency

vatRegime.description: VAT regime applied to the commitment.
vatRegime.title: VAT Regime

status.description: Commitment lifecycle state. Derived from the latest Verplichtingsmutatie (D1).
status.title: Status

mandateApplied.description: FK to the Mandate under whose authority this commitment was signed (REQ-VPL-002), joined on its mandateCode.
mandateApplied.title: Mandate Applied

overrideReason.description: Audit-trail reason recorded when a budget-exceeding commitment is force-accepted under an override-mandate (REQ-VPL-001).
overrideReason.title: Override Reden

internalReference.description: Optional internal reference (contract number, dossier, etc.).
internalReference.title: Interne Kenmerk

lawfulnessChecks.description: Optional FKs to rechtmatigheidstoetsen attached at commitment-time (REQ-VPL-010). Nullable; gated on bookkeeping-rechtmatigheidsverantwoording being installed.
lawfulnessChecks.title: Rechtmatigheidstoetsen

documents.description: File URIs (e.g. docudesk) for the signed PO/contract/beschikking.
documents.title: Documents

lines.description: The commitment's budget-tracking lines, one per budget coding combination / fiscal year (D2). This is the INVERSE side of CommitmentLine.commitment — it exists as a real property because ADR-062 rule 7 expresses relations as property-level $ref, and a one-to-many with no local property had nowhere to carry one. Values join on CommitmentLine's commitment field (the commitmentNumber), so this is deliberately not format:uuid.
lines.title: Lines

movements.description: The immutable movement log for this commitment (D1) — every state change is recorded as a CommitmentMovement. Inverse side of CommitmentMovement.commitment, expressed as a property for the same reason as `lines`.
movements.title: Movements

draft.label: Concept
draft.description: Commitment drafted, not yet signed. No budget impact.

pendingApproval.label: In goedkeuring
pendingApproval.description: Mandate exceeded; routed to a goedkeuringsstap approval chain (REQ-VPL-002, D7).

committed.label: Aangegaan
committed.description: Signed/legally binding. Budget is blocked; an aangegaan Verplichtingsmutatie is recorded (REQ-VPL-001/003).

partiallyDelivered.label: Deels geleverd
partiallyDelivered.description: Goods/services partially received (prestatie_ontvangen). Informational; no budget change (REQ-VPL-003).

partiallyInvoiced.label: Deels gefactureerd
partiallyInvoiced.description: Partially invoiced; restant_verplicht reduced and AP invoice matched (REQ-VPL-003).

partiallyPaid.label: Deels betaald
partiallyPaid.description: Partially paid; no further budget impact (REQ-VPL-003).

closed.label: Afgesloten
closed.description: Closed; remaining restant released back to budget (REQ-VPL-006).

cancelled.label: Geannuleerd
cancelled.description: Cancelled; reversal mutatie posted and openstaande_verplichtingen reduced (REQ-VPL-006). Remains queryable for audit.

indienen.label: Ter goedkeuring aanbieden
indienen.description: Offer for approval when the signer's mandaat is insufficient. Gated by MandateEnforcer (REQ-VPL-002).

aangaan.label: Verplichting aangaan
aangaan.description: Sign the commitment within mandaat and budget. Gated by MandateEnforcer (mandaat sufficient) and BudgetBlocker (vrije_ruimte sufficient or override). An aangegaan Verplichtingsmutatie is recorded (REQ-VPL-001/002).

actions.description: Record an aangegaan Verplichtingsmutatie and increase openstaande_verplichtingen on the matching budgets (REQ-VPL-001/003).

approve.label: Goedkeuren
approve.description: Approval chain completed; the commitment becomes binding. Gated by BudgetBlocker (REQ-VPL-002).

factureren.label: Factureren
factureren.description: Invoice matched against the commitment; restant_verplicht reduced (REQ-VPL-003).

betalen.label: Betalen
betalen.description: Payment settled; openstaande_verplichtingen unchanged (already released at gefactureerd, REQ-VPL-003).

afsluiten.label: Afsluiten
afsluiten.description: Close the commitment; restant released back to budget (REQ-VPL-006).

annuleren.label: Annuleren
annuleren.description: Cancel; reversal mutatie posted, openstaande_verplichtingen reduced (REQ-VPL-006).

commitment-approval.description: Approval chain that gates the Verplichting in_goedkeuring -> aangegaan `goedkeuren` transition (REQ-VPL-013). A commitment reaches in_goedkeuring only when MandateEnforcer::requiresApproval routed it there because the signer's mandaat was insufficient (REQ-VPL-002); this chain then runs the finance approval workflow that releases it. Threshold-routed on totaalbedrag_excl_btw (EUR cents): a single commitment-administrator approves from EUR 0, and a finance-director approves commitments at or above EUR 250.000. Separation of duties is enforced - the requester who submitted the commitment cannot approve their own step. On completion the goedkeuren transition auto-advances (BudgetBlocker still gates the budget). Declarative metadata only: OpenRegister's approval-workflow primitive (x-openregister-approval-chains, ApprovalChainGateListener/ApprovalChainAdvanceListener) materialises and gates the actual steps; this app ships no PHP approval-chain implementation. INERT until the OpenRegister release carrying the declarative approval-chains capability (PR #396/#397) is deployed - see openspec/changes/migrate-mandaat-to-approval-chains/design.md for the sequencing and the named follow-up.

CommitmentLine.title: CommitmentLine
CommitmentLine.description: A budget-tracking line on a Verplichting, one per budget coderingscombinatie (programma + kostenplaats + boekjaar + grootboekrekening). Each regel tracks its own delivery, invoicing, and payment independently so multi-year raamovereenkomsten block budget per boekjaar (D2, REQ-VPL-004).

administrationId.description: FK to the owning Administration (tenant isolation).
administrationId.title: Administration ID

commitment.description: FK to the parent Commitment, joined on its commitmentNumber. Carries the canonical property-level $ref (ADR-062 rule 7) rather than a per-schema x-openregister-relations block. Deliberately NOT format:uuid — this join is on the business key, and declaring uuid would reject every existing value.
commitment.title: Commitment

lineNumber.description: Sequential line number within the verplichting.
lineNumber.title: Regelnummer

fiscalYear.description: Fiscal year this line's budget is consumed from (REQ-VPL-004).
fiscalYear.title: Fiscal Year

amountExclVat.description: Committed amount excluding VAT, in minor units (EUR cents).
amountExclVat.title: Amount Excl VAT

amountInclVat.description: Committed amount including VAT, in minor units.
amountInclVat.title: Amount Incl VAT

programme.description: BBV taakveld / programma code, ties the commitment to a budget bucket (REQ-VPL-009).
programme.title: Programma

vatCode.description: VAT code applied to the line.
vatCode.title: BTW Code

deliveredAmount.description: Aggregated received amount, in minor units (informational; no budget impact).
deliveredAmount.title: Delivered Amount

invoicedAmount.description: Aggregated invoiced amount, in minor units.
invoicedAmount.title: Invoiced Amount

paidAmount.description: Aggregated paid amount, in minor units.
paidAmount.title: Paid Amount

committedVsRealisedPerBudgetLine.description: REQ-VPL-011: per-budget-line committed-vs-realised rollup, grouped by budget coderingscombinatie (programma + kostenplaats + boekjaar + grootboekrekening). Excludes afgesloten regels. verplicht = sum(restant_verplicht); gerealiseerd = sum(gefactureerd_bedrag); geautoriseerd is joined from the matching Budget (administrationId + programmaCode = programma + boekjaar); vrij = geautoriseerd - verplicht - gerealiseerd is computed by the drilldown view (BudgetLineCommitments.vue) from these three declared figures — no parallel PHP reporting service (ADR-031).

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a Verplichtingsregel is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp (REQ-AT-001).

CommitmentMovement.title: CommitmentMovement
CommitmentMovement.description: Immutable audit-log entry for every change to a Verplichting (D1, REQ-VPL-010). The verplichting.status is derived from the latest mutatie. Bedrag may be negative for geannuleerd/verlaagd/teruggevorderd; aggregations track sign explicitly.

administrationId.description: FK to the owning Administration (tenant isolation).
administrationId.title: Administration ID

commitment.description: FK to the parent Commitment, joined on its commitmentNumber. Carries the canonical property-level $ref (ADR-062 rule 7) rather than a per-schema x-openregister-relations block. Deliberately NOT format:uuid — this join is on the business key, and declaring uuid would reject every existing value.
commitment.title: Commitment

commitmentLine.description: Optional FK to the specific Verplichtingsregel affected.
commitmentLine.title: CommitmentLine

amount.description: Movement amount in minor units (EUR cents); may be negative for decreased/cancelled/reclaimed.
amount.title: Amount

relatedInvoice.description: Optional FK to the AP/AR Invoice this mutation relates to.
relatedInvoice.title: Gerelateerde Factuur

Mandate.title: Mandate
Mandate.description: Authorization record defining who may sign commitments up to what amount, for which soort_verplichting, with optional second-signature thresholds (D6, REQ-VPL-002). Enforced by MandateEnforcer on the verplichting aangaan transition. A register (not an enum) so operators can manage mandates over time.

administrationId.description: FK to the owning Administration (tenant isolation).
administrationId.title: Administration ID

mandateCode.description: Unique mandate code within the administration.
mandateCode.title: Mandate Code

houder.description: FK to a Nextcloud user or role that holds the mandate.
houder.title: Houder

houder_type.description: Whether houder references a user, a role, or a team.
houder_type.title: Houder Type

maximumAmount.description: Ceiling amount this mandate may sign, in minor units (EUR cents). Use a very large value for unlimited.
maximumAmount.title: Maximum Amount

commitmentType.description: Commitment kinds this mandate applies to.
commitmentType.title: Commitment Type

isOverride.description: Whether this mandate may force-accept a budget-exceeding commitment with an audit-trail reason (REQ-VPL-001).
isOverride.title: Is Override

uitsluitingen.description: Optional textual exclusions narrowing the mandate.
uitsluitingen.title: Uitsluitingen

geldig_tot.description: Mandate validity end. Expired mandates are treated as absent (REQ-VPL-002).
geldig_tot.title: Geldig Tot

vastgesteld_bij.description: Legal reference under which the mandate was established (e.g. Mandaatregeling Gemeentewet 168).
vastgesteld_bij.title: Vastgesteld Bij

secondSignatureRequiredAbove.description: Amount above which a second signature is required, in minor units (REQ-VPL-002).
secondSignatureRequiredAbove.title: Vereist Tweede Handtekening Boven

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a Mandaat is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp (REQ-AT-001).

ApprovalStep.title: ApprovalStep
ApprovalStep.description: A workflow step in a commitment's approval chain when the signer's mandaat is exceeded (D7, REQ-VPL-002). Created by MandateEnforcer when a verplichting moves to in_goedkeuring; gives finance a clear view of pending approvals.

administrationId.description: FK to the owning Administration (tenant isolation).
administrationId.title: Administration ID

commitment.description: FK to the Commitment awaiting approval, joined on its commitmentNumber.
commitment.title: Commitment

stepNumber.description: Sequential step number in the approval chain.
stepNumber.title: Step Number

rol_vereist.description: Role required to action this step.
rol_vereist.title: Rol Vereist

toegewezen_aan.description: FK to the Nextcloud user assigned this step.
toegewezen_aan.title: Toegewezen Aan

vereist_handtekening.description: Whether this step requires a digital signature.
vereist_handtekening.title: Vereist Handtekening

handtekening_bestand.description: File URI of the captured signature.
handtekening_bestand.title: Handtekening Bestand

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a Goedkeuringsstap is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp (REQ-AT-001).

Budget.title: Budget
Budget.description: Per-programma / per-boekjaar budget bucket. Verplichtingenadministratie introduces this register (no prior Budget schema exists in shillinq) so budget can be blocked at commitment-time. vrije_ruimte = authorisedAmount - realisedAmount - outstandingCommitments, evaluated on-demand (D4/D9, REQ-VPL-001).

administrationId.description: FK to the owning Administration (tenant isolation).
administrationId.title: Administration ID

programmeCode.description: BBV programma / taakveld code this budget covers.
programmeCode.title: Programma Code

costCentre.description: Optional cost-centre scope for the budget.
costCentre.title: Cost Centre

authorisedAmount.description: Authorised budget, in minor units (EUR cents).
authorisedAmount.title: Authorised Amount

outstandingCommitments.description: Outstanding commitments aggregated from Verplichtingsregels, in minor units (D9, REQ-VPL-001).
outstandingCommitments.title: Outstanding Commitments

vrije_ruimte.description: Calculated free budget = authorisedAmount - realisedAmount - outstandingCommitments (D9).
vrije_ruimte.title: Vrije Ruimte

outstandingCommitments.description: On-demand sum of outstanding committed amounts for this programma + boekjaar; not cached (D9, REQ-VPL-001).
